Set the software state recorded for a subsystem.

detaileddescription.para: Validates the pointer and state, stores the state, and verifies the stored value to detect a fault during the update. No hardware registers are written.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem whose State field is updated.
New state; must be less than MAX_STATE.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if the state is stored, XST_INVALID_PARAM for an invalid pointer or state, or XST_GLITCH_ERROR if verification fails.

detaileddescription.para: Copies Subsystem->State to DeviceStatus->Status.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem whose state is queried.
Output structure that receives the state.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, or XST_INVALID_PARAM if either pointer is NULL.

briefdescription.para: Request every unallocated device marked for preallocation.

detaileddescription.para: The caller retains error reporting so its function name remains in each log prefix. This helper identifies the failing condition and, for a rejected request, returns the device ID needed by that report.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem whose requirement list is processed.
Output device ID when a device request fails.

simplesect.para: XPM_PREALLOC_REQ_NONE after processing the full list, or the precise condition that stopped requirement processing.

briefdescription.para: Activate and configure a subsystem's preallocated devices.

detaileddescription.para: Marks a powered-off subsystem online, requests each unallocated preallocated device, and sets SUBSYSTEM_IS_CONFIGURED after all requests succeed.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem to activate and configure.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if already configured or all preallocations succeed; XST_INVALID_PARAM for a NULL subsystem; XST_FAILURE for malformed requirement data; or XPM_ERR_DEVICE_REQ if a device request fails.

briefdescription.para: Dispatch a node access check to its class-specific permission checker.

detaileddescription.para: Power and unsupported classes remain denied through the failure initializer. Supported classes retain temporal redundancy around their permission checks.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem requesting access.
Node whose access permission is checked.

simplesect.para: XST_FAILURE for an unsupported class, or the selected permission checker's status.

briefdescription.para: Validate the PMC identity with two independent comparisons.

detaileddescription.para: A stable non-PMC identity retains the failure status so a fault in the caller cannot turn the privileged bypass into a grant. If the first comparison identifies PMC, a second volatile read must independently identify PMC.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem whose ID is checked.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS for PMC, XST_FAILURE for a stable non-PMC identity, or XST_GLITCH_ERROR when the two PMC decisions disagree.

briefdescription.para: Check whether a subsystem may access a node.

detaileddescription.para: PMC access is accepted directly. Clock, reset, device, and pin requests are dispatched to their permission checkers; power and unsupported node classes remain denied. A denial is logged.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem requesting access.
Node whose access permission is checked.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when access is allowed, XPM_INVALID_SUBSYSID for a NULL subsystem, XST_GLITCH_ERROR if the redundant PMC-ID check disagrees, XST_FAILURE for a power or unsupported node class, or the selected permission checker's failure status.
